sync.title: Sync folder contents
sync.description: Recursively sync directory contents without nesting the source folder.
sync.excludesHint: Add one exact file or directory name at a time, matching at every level. Paths and wildcards are not supported.
sync.pendingExcludeHint: Add or clear the name before previewing changes.
sync.rule: Copy missing files and files newer on the source, comparing modification times in seconds. Skip equal or newer targets. Keep destination-only files; do not merge file contents. Transfer a changes-only archive and compare again when executing.
sync.omittedPreviewItems: Entries in this category were not included in the returned preview list.
sync.conflictsHint: Resolve or exclude type conflicts and unsupported entries, then preview again.
sync.truncated: Showing up to 1000 entries, prioritizing conflicts and changes. Counts include all entries.
sync.resetHint: Restore defaults for this dialog. Settings are saved only after a successful sync.
sync.loadFailed: Could not load saved sync settings. Choose the directory and settings again.
sync.saveFailed: Sync succeeded, but its settings could not be saved.
sync.excludeOptionsHint: Preset exclusions match exact names at every level. .git excludes both files and directories; the other presets exclude directories only.
sync.gitignoreHint: Use .gitignore files in the selected source directory and its subdirectories, including ! exceptions. Destination and global rules are not used. Explicit exclusions take precedence; matching tracked files are excluded too.
sync.invalidExclude: Enter one valid name without paths, commas, or control characters.
